name: Deiva Mani Kailasam
title: Senior AI Engineer | GenAI · Agentic AI · LLMOps
bio: Senior software engineer with 9 years building cloud-native, multi-tenant platforms serving multiple clients and agencies, the last 3 taking GenAI and agentic AI from business problem to production. Works with business stakeholders to qualify use cases, define success metrics and build ROI cases, then designs and ships end to end: RAG pipelines, LangGraph multi-agent workflows, Cortex Analyst text-to-SQL agents, guardrails and evaluation suites on Amazon Bedrock. Full-stack across Python, TypeScript, Java/Spring Boot and React/Angular. Owns delivery from architecture to CI/CD and observability; mentored 5 engineers (3 promoted).
